findings.finding: Packs whole source sheets; reducing their dimensions reduces the packing footprint.

Preloads each animation family's own sheet even when its parts image paths reference another family. Middle/slow keep valid 8x8 transparent sheets and empty atlas entries; all consumed images resolve to the fast sheet already loaded by both skill variants.
Rotated packed width/height and frame offsets are reconstructed by the independent rendered-frame validator.
Native ticket requirement also gates guests on possession. Enabling it would violate the existing host-only ticket rule.
